dataset._validation_note: Validation = the 3,064 of 6,480 clips whose noise_ytid is NOT in AudioSet's labelled train set (the same 'clean' subset as FRCRN_KD_MoE and mix-dataset-v2 'eval'). Train is all 30,240 clips; test is never used to select.

backbone._note: Same checkpoint as the mid project (sha256 e5815275...). dropout/layerdrop override the checkpoint cfg (0.0/0.05) with the BEATs paper's fine-tuning values.
backbone._note_head: head_init random (user 2026-11-07: 'head phai khoi tao ngau nhien, khong duoc dung head audioset'), nhu baseline nhom MLNC ce9 ('new random 36-class head'); ap cho ca teacher noi bo cua cac run KD/CRD. Con lai = train_config_beats_ce15.json.

teacher._recipe_note: Fine-model cross-entropy benchmark recipe (user table, 2026-11-04): 15 epochs, effective batch 64 (32 x 2), AdamW wd 0.01, BEATs lr encoder 1e-5 / head 1e-4, 2-epoch warm-up then cosine (warmup_fraction 2/15), unweighted CE without label smoothing, Mixup or SpecAugment, grad-norm clip 1.0, bf16, seed 2026, checkpoint = highest validation accuracy over epochs 1..15, earlier epoch kept on ties. Not in the table and kept from train_config_beats_fullsnr.json: all 12 blocks trainable, no layer-wise decay (table gives one encoder lr), dropout/layerdrop 0.1. Modules the table does not name (FiLM, attention pool, CRD student projection) take the head lr 1e-4 instead of the old 1e-3.

attention._note: Soft attention mask A(t,f) over the patch tokens (direction 2, run7_attn). hidden=128 matches FiLM and the CRD projection; lr matches film_lr, the rate every other new module here uses. Neither value comes from a paper for this task.

student._recipe_note: Fine-model cross-entropy benchmark recipe (user table, 2026-11-04): 15 epochs, effective batch 64 (32 x 2), AdamW wd 0.01, BEATs lr encoder 1e-5 / head 1e-4, 2-epoch warm-up then cosine (warmup_fraction 2/15), unweighted CE without label smoothing, Mixup or SpecAugment, grad-norm clip 1.0, bf16, seed 2026, checkpoint = highest validation accuracy over epochs 1..15, earlier epoch kept on ties. Not in the table and kept from train_config_beats_fullsnr.json: all 12 blocks trainable, no layer-wise decay (table gives one encoder lr), dropout/layerdrop 0.1. Modules the table does not name (FiLM, attention pool, CRD student projection) take the head lr 1e-4 instead of the old 1e-3.

loss._note: crd_level 'patch' aligns every patch token against the teacher's; 'pooled' reproduces the BEATs project's single-vector CRD. patch is the reason for switching backbones - see VERSIONS.md. Weights r/a/b come from the CRD reference repo (-r 1 -a 1 -b 0.8); do not invent replacements.

gates._teacher_gate_note: Gate = baseline_band_accuracy + 0.10 = 0.6315. The mid project's absolute 0.75 floor sat above a 0.67 mixture baseline; carried to this band (baseline 0.53) it stopped a clean-noise teacher of 0.738, which is 0.21 above the baseline - twice the mid project's teacher headroom (0.78 - 0.67 = 0.11). Flagged as uncalibrated for SSLAM/high from the first commit; recalibrated after the teacher sweep of 2026-09-28.
gates._baseline_band_note: Published BEATs-Mixture, Result.xlsx 'Theo tung SNR': (0.5769@15dB + 0.4861@20dB)/2 and (0.5757+0.4830)/2, equal support (1080 each). This is the gate; it is NOT the same run as BEATs_Experts/checkpoint/test_metrics_36.json (that checkpoint's own 15/20 numbers are 0.6102/0.5315 - a different training run, no per-clip predictions, cannot enter a paired test).

published_baseline.name: BEATs-Mixture (Result.xlsx)
published_baseline._note: Copied from Result.xlsx, sheet 'Theo tung SNR', rows BEATs-Mixture / final, all six levels (the band-only report keeps 15 and 20; --full-test uses all). Only accuracy and F1 exist there, and no per-clip predictions, so it cannot enter the McNemar comparison.

evaluation._note: One model for every SNR: train on all six levels, select on the whole (filtered) validation split (select_on='full' overrides each run's own choice).
